ios.desc:
Display Your Stripe Project’s Revenue Like Never Before!

Now you can have lovely widgets on your iPhone, Mac**, or iPad displaying key information about your business.

The perfect screenshot flex for social media:

Free features:
	•	Connect one Stripe project
	•	Revenue widgets
	•	Display data in the time frame that fits your needs

Premium features (additional in-app purchase required):
	•	Chart widgets
	•	Grid Contribution Graph — like your GitHub one
	•	MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) widgets
	•	Pie widgets
	•	Add unlimited Stripe projects

Note: You can have the same widgets as on your iPhone if you have a MacBook with an Apple Silicon chipset.

—————————————————————————————————————————
